verdict.rationale: FireHydrant has several built-in AI features that take specific tasks off users' hands: the 'Draft with AI' button drafts retrospective sections, AI writes incident summaries tailored to different audiences, a Scribe captures meeting discussions, and a Copilot suggests related incidents in the Command Center and Slack. These are fixed, feature-bound automations rather than a general assistant that accepts and carries out arbitrary user-delegated tasks. Missing for 10: a general-purpose conversational assistant that takes free-form instructions, evidence of the AI taking actions (e.g. running runbooks or updating incidents) on request, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
